offer.text: A big order came in — saddles, satchels, the lot. I'll need 12 leather to fill it.

accept.text: Good hide makes good coin. Off you go.

decline.text: I'll tell them it's delayed, then.

ready.text: Twelve hides! The tannery will run all night.

complete.text: A fine haul. There's a cut of the profit in it for you.
